purpose: Test whether semantically unrelated value updates cause functional losses as the number of simultaneously active facts increases, while holding record count and audited token positions fixed. This is a native-model diagnostic for the hybrid-block update question, not a new architecture or confirmation study.

gate.data_registration: Before any new model inference, freeze a separate dataset manifest containing data, registry, tokenizer, implementation and this protocol's hashes. Verify executable truths, all prescribed token alignments and all paired identities.

prefix_construction.entity_namespace: E700 through E899, exactly three decimal digits after E
prefix_construction.entity_rng: For each base seed, random.Random(base_seed) shuffles the fixed ordered 200-name namespace once. Its first three names are A, B and C in every load and value condition.
prefix_construction.records_0_1_2: SET A old_A; SET B old_B; SET C old_C. These positions stay identical across loads.
prefix_construction.remaining_records: Use exactly the first active_accounts-3 names after A,B,C in the entity permutation. Concatenate independently shuffled permutations of these names using schedule_rng until there are 157 targets, then truncate to 157. Emit one SET per target. Every registered active account appears; none of these records writes A, B or C.
prefix_construction.value_assignment: Sample 4*162 distinct integers from range(100,1000). For value version v, take its contiguous 162-integer slice. The first 160 entries supply the corresponding prefix record values, entry160 is new_A and entry161 is new_C. Reuse this exact record-index value schedule at all loads. old_A,old_B,old_C are entries0,1,2.
prefix_construction.interpretation: The query-related facts have the same ages, slots, names and values at all loads. The number and recurrence of distractor account identities changes. A load contrast alone does not isolate state capacity from changes in input representations.

tail_construction.record_160: SET A old_A when A0, otherwise SET A new_A
tail_construction.record_161: SET C old_C when C0, otherwise SET C new_C
tail_construction.semantic_baseline: A0_C0 repeats the currently effective values. It is a semantic no-op, not skipped neural computation.
tail_construction.controlled_difference: For a fixed base seed, load and value version, all four cells have identical operation types, target identities, record count, queries, causal positions and prompt lengths. Toggling A or C changes only the registered three value-digit tokens at that tail record.
tail_construction.truth: target_current depends only on the A bit; protected_current for B and target_initial for A remain unchanged in all four cells. Toggling C must preserve every registered query answer.

required_data_audits: Every example's answer is recomputed by the existing executable SET interpreter; no LLM labels.
Every load has exactly160 prefix and2 tail records and exactly the prescribed number of distinct active accounts.
The four value siblings have identical questions, entity identities, operation schedules and token positions, with four distinct answers for each fixed tail cell and query role.

Within every base-seed/value/role pairing, all loads and tail cells have equal prompt lengths and identical query token suffixes. Tail toggles differ only in the prescribed three isolated digit tokens.
A and B first occur at slots0 and1 respectively, and no distractor operation modifies A,B,C. Every record boundary and value span is token-registered.
No prompt exceeds4096 tokens; failure aborts registration without dropping long examples or changing the grid after inference.
No existing confirmation cohort or70000-series examples are consumed. These four newly specified base streams are explicitly development diagnostics.

evaluation.runtime: Reuse the existing text-only local eager BF16 runtime and account-ledger instructions; every natural full-reader query is processed by the unmodified hybrid model.
evaluation.primary_readout: Unrestricted greedy generation, maximum12 new tokens, stop on newline or EOS. Save complete decoded output and parse with the existing exact-answer criterion. No gold candidate restriction.
evaluation.secondary_readout: Gold three-digit answer NLL with the same fixed answer tokenization; report separately from free accuracy.
evaluation.required_controls: Frozen backbone checks before/after, no adapters or training, actual history access at all six Attention layers on prescribed first/last identities, complete raw rows and source hashes. Determine the exact ordered evaluation registry before inference.
primary_reports: All576 answer outcomes and denominators, by registered load, tail cell and role.
For both C-bit values, paired A0-to-A1 rescues/regressions for protected_current and target_initial, plus correct target-current updates.
For both A-bit values, paired C0-to-C1 rescues/regressions for all three answer-invariant roles.
Joint update-and-preservation success and complete four-value sibling success; do not filter to initially correct examples for the main table.
Keep baseline-correct conditional regression rates secondary, with every numerator/denominator and all baseline failures visible.
Give all four base-stream results and treat their value siblings, loads and query roles as related observations. No independent-n576 confidence claim.
Report NLL shifts continuously without treating a tiny probability change as semantic memory damage.

decision_rules.screen_signal: An answer-invariant tail toggle produces a correct-to-incorrect free-answer regression in at least two of the four base streams at a registered load. This is a descriptive development screen, not a significance test or confirmed causal mechanism.
decision_rules.if_signal_absent: Record that this fixed-length load screen does not supply the missing motivation for semantic write-locality co-design. Do not initiate B/C structures or expand load thresholds only to manufacture a failure. Keep any NLL-only observations descriptive.
decision_rules.if_signal_present: Before training another architecture, register a separate replication and event-level state/KV diagnostic with aligned natural controls. A natural functional regression does not by itself locate damage in GDN, exclude Attention addressing, or prove a shared controller is necessary.
decision_rules.architecture_gate: Any later shared controller must still beat independent controllers, single-component adaptations and ordinary data/local adaptation at matched budgets while retaining required order, COPY snapshot and historical-query competence. This SET-only screen does not replace those existing semantic tests.

implementation_status: Protocol only. No new dataset generated, no runner implemented, no model inference and no scheduled training for this screen at registration.
